eir_cattle_raid_cb = {
	group = conquest
	icon = county_conquest_cb
	ai = no

	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	allow_hostages = no
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }
	interface_priority = 70

	attacker_score_from_occupation_scale = 150
	attacker_score_from_battles_scale = 150
	defender_score_from_battles_scale = 150

	allowed_for_character = {
		eir_act_gael_host_trigger = yes
		is_landed = yes
		NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_landless_adventurer }
	}

	allowed_for_character_display_regardless = {
		tgp_japan_offensive_wars_ban_trigger = yes
	}

	allowed_against_character = {
		scope:attacker = {
			NOT = { top_liege = scope:defender.top_liege }
		}
		OR = {
			character_is_land_realm_neighbor = scope:attacker
			AND = {
				exists = scope:attacker.liege
				character_is_land_realm_neighbor = scope:attacker.liege
			}
		}
	}

	target_titles = neighbor_land
	target_title_tier = county
	target_de_jure_regions_above = no
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder

	valid_to_start = {
		exists = scope:target
		NOT = {
			scope:target.title_province = { has_province_modifier = recently_looted_modifier }
		}
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				holder = { target_is_same_character_or_above = scope:defender }
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalidated_desc = eir_cattle_raid_cb_invalidated_desc
	on_invalidated = {}

	cost = {
		prestige = {
			value = minor_prestige_value
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = {
		on_declared_war = yes
	}

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = eir_cattle_raid_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = eir_cattle_raid_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}

	on_victory = {
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			add_gold = medium_gold_value
			add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_cattle_plunder_modifier
				years = 5
			}
		}
		scope:defender = {
			remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			title_province = {
				add_province_modifier = {
					modifier = recently_looted_modifier
					years = 5
				}
			}
			change_development_level = -1
		}
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:attacker
			FAME_BASE = minor_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			desc = eir_cattle_raid_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}

	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = {
				value = miniscule_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			desc = eir_cattle_raid_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}

	on_defeat = {
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:defender = {
			add_prestige_war_defender_effect = {
				PRESTIGE_VALUE = medium_prestige_value
			}
		}
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = {
				GOLD_VALUE = 1
			}
			add_prestige = medium_prestige_loss
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = loser
		}
		on_lost_aggression_war_discontent_loss = yes
	}

	transfer_behavior = transfer
	on_primary_attacker_death = invalidate
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	attacker_allies_inherit = no
	defender_allies_inherit = no

	war_name = "EIR_CATTLE_RAID_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "EIR_CATTLE_RAID_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "EIR_CATTLE_RAID_CB_NAME"

	use_de_jure_wargoal_only = yes
	defender_ticking_warscore_delay = { months = 3 }
	defender_ticking_warscore = 0.15
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 1
	attacker_ticking_warscore = 1
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 100
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 1
	ticking_war_score_targets_entire_realm = no
}

	group = subjugation

	defender_score_from_battles_scale = 150

		NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_landless_adventurer }
		highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
	}

	allowed_for_character_display_regardless = {
		tgp_japan_offensive_wars_ban_trigger = yes
	}

	allowed_against_character = {
		scope:defender = {
			top_liege = this
			is_landed = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:attacker = { is_ai = no } }
				scope:attacker = {
					any_neighboring_top_liege_realm_owner = {
						this = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
		scope:attacker.primary_title.tier >= scope:defender.primary_title.tier
	}

	cost = {
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				desc = CB_SIZE_OF_TARGET_REALM_COST
				scope:defender = {
					every_sub_realm_county = {
						add = {
							value = 40
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		scope:defender = {
			top_liege != this
		}
	}

	on_declaration = {
		on_declared_war = yes
	}

	on_invalidated = {}

		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = eir_cain_demand_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = eir_cain_demand_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}

	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_gold = major_gold_value
			add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
			add_dread = minor_dread_gain
			add_hook = {
				target = scope:defender
				type = favor_hook
			}
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_cain_received_modifier
				years = 10
			}
		}
		scope:defender = {
			remove_short_term_gold = medium_gold_value
			add_prestige = minor_prestige_loss
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_owes_cain_modifier
				years = 10
			}
		}
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:attacker
			FAME_BASE = medium_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes

	on_white_peace_desc = {

	on_white_peace = {

eir_tanist_claim_cb = {
	group = conquest
	icon = county_conquest_cb
	ai = no

	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }
	interface_priority = 72

	allowed_for_character = {
		eir_act_gael_host_trigger = yes
		is_landed = yes
		NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_landless_adventurer }
	}

	allowed_for_character_display_regardless = {
		tgp_japan_offensive_wars_ban_trigger = yes
	}

	allowed_against_character = {
		scope:attacker = {
			ALL_FALSE = {
				top_liege = scope:defender.top_liege
				liege = scope:defender
			}
		}
		scope:defender = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					exists = dynasty
					dynasty = scope:attacker.dynasty
				}
				is_close_or_extended_family_of = scope:attacker
			}
		}
	}

	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = county
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder

	attacker_score_from_occupation_scale = 150
	attacker_score_from_battles_scale = 150
	defender_score_from_battles_scale = 150

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			is_landless_type_title = no
			neighboring_county_or_viking_conquest_trigger = { CHARACTER = root }
		}
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder = {
						OR = {
							this = scope:defender
							target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalidated_desc = eir_tanist_claim_cb_invalidated_desc
	on_invalidated = {}

	cost = {
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				value = 5
				multiply = scope:attacker.realm_size
				desc = CB_REALM_SIZE_COST
				max = 100
			}
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = {
		on_declared_war = yes
	}

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = eir_tanist_claim_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = eir_tanist_claim_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}

	on_victory = {
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			change_title_holder = {
				holder = scope:attacker
				change = scope:change
			}
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		}
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:attacker
			FAME_BASE = minor_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			desc = eir_tanist_claim_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}

	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = {
				value = minor_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {

			desc = eir_tanist_claim_cb_defeat_desc

		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes

		}

		scope:attacker = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = loser
